attempts.raw_response: The celebration continued backstage as current cast members gathered to mark the milestone, which has seen the show become one of the West End's longest-running productions. Wicked opened at the Apollo Victoria theatre in 2006 and has since welcomed over 10 million visitors. In other theatre news, the Broadway production of The Curious Incident of the Dog in the Night-Time received five Tony nominations, including Best Play. Meanwhile, the film adaptation of the hit musical Into the Woods opened in US cinemas, with Meryl Streep, Emily Blunt, and Johnny Depp starring in the Disney production. The movie, directed by Rob Marshall, also featured singer Idina Menzel performing her signature song "Let It Go."

pair.human_continuation: There are also plans to mark the 30th anniversary of The Phantom of the Opera with a charity gala at Her Majesty's Theatre in London. Some tickets for the performance on 10 October have been priced £19.86, to mark the musical's first performance at the theatre in 1986. The current cast will be joined by members of the original company and some "special guests" at the end of the performance. Michael Crawford, who created the role of The Phantom in Andrew Lloyd Webber's musical, is currently appearing in West End musical The Go-Between. Former cast members Kerry Ellis and Adam Garcia were among those in the audience at Tuesday's performance of the Wizard of Oz-inspired musical.
